limitations: Each row adds three or four components together; nonlinear interactions and the row-specific background mask are aliased into the coefficients.
Centering removes the transition mean, so the analysis estimates only relative component associations and cannot allocate a common shell effect.
The centered 47-row design spans every zero-mean row pattern; exact in-sample reconstruction is automatic and is not model evidence.
Leave-one-context-out stability reuses the same fixed masks and 12-context cohort; it is not independent replication.
The ranking and top-k shortlist are post-hoc. Candidates require fresh single-component, dropout, or targeted recomposition interventions.
recommended_next_test: freeze a small shortlist before new queries, then compare each candidate's add-one and leave-one-out effect on fresh contexts at the scale where it ranked
